description: Tools and guidance for the headline Unreal Engine 5.8 features: Procedural Vegetation Editor (Nanite-foliage trees from a node graph), Control Rig Physics & Dynamics, Direct Mesh Controls, MetaHuman (Mesh to MetaHuman, build, crowds), 5.8 rendering presets (MegaLights production, Lumen Lite, Substrate NPR, Fog Screen Space Scattering, Nanite Foliage), one-call Physics Asset generation for fast iteration, and Game Animation Sample (5.8) integration.
catalog_blurb: PVE, Control Rig Physics, DMC, MetaHuman, 5.8 rendering, Physics Asset, GASP.
